I am a 32-year-old farmer in Mwanza with just over one hectare of land, so I must be careful with every shilling I spend. For my tubers plot, I will rely on manure from our animals because chemical fertilizer is too expensive for root crops, and I will plant the local cassava varieties I have always saved from last season since they grow well here and cost me nothing. I do not have money for pesticides or irrigation equipment, so I will depend on the rains and pull weeds by hand with my family. We will work this plot ourselves throughout the season, and while the planting and harvesting times will be busy, my household can manage the labor without hiring outsiders.
